specifications.

 Training & Knowledge Sharing: Assist in training plant operators and other staff

 Problem-Solving Abilities: Ability to troubleshoot and resolve operational issues

 Project Management: Experience with project coordination, including managing

 Team Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team

environment.

 Attention to Detail: Strong focus on ensuring high standards in both operational

performance and regulatory compliance.

 Health and Safety Awareness: Familiarity with safety protocols and regulations

in the water treatment and construction industry.

 A Diploma or Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Civil

Engineering, or a related field.

 Additional certifications in water treatment or related areas are a plus.

Experience:

 3-5 years of experience in water treatment plant operations or related industries.

 Prior experience in handling water treatment equipment, such as pumps, valves,

filtration systems, and chemical dosing systems, is preferred.

 Can coordinate with the head office and project site.

 Can handle the project independently

 Can travel anywhere in India.

Desired Candidate Attributes:

 Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.

 Proactive and solution-oriented approach.

 Ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to a dynamic work environment.

 Passionate about contributing to sustainable and environmentally responsible

water treatment solutions.

This role is crucial for the successful operation and continuous improvement of water

treatment systems, ensuring safe and clean water for communities.

title: Project Leader – AMS Automotive
description:
### **About Us**

Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network), with its nodes across various geographies.

BCN is an integral and largest unit of ECD (Expert Client Delivery). ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries and specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, or Bain intellectual property.

The BCN comprises Consulting Services, Knowledge Services, and Shared Services.

### **Who You Will Work With**

This is an opportunity to be a part of Bain’s AMS CoE, based out of the Gurugram office, and specifically support Bain Global case teams on live cases, client development, and proposal support.

AMS CoE consists of 70+ team members, organized into approximately 18 teams, working across various sectors such as real estate/construction, heavy machinery, commercial aviation, logistics & transport, and automotive & mobility.

You will work on AMS projects and get exposed to various BCN products ranging from go-to-market strategies, industry analysis, and competitive benchmarking to Excel models, survey analysis, and ad-hoc studies, on live client cases as well as for business/client development.

Project Leaders lead teams of analysts and associates to produce client-ready research and analysis, generating strong business insights and providing implications.

Project Leaders work under the guidance of a Manager/Sr. Manager, playing a key role in driving the team’s overall answer and final materials, client communication, work planning, and team management.

The expectation is to eventually provide significant direction and support to resolve complex issues and effectively manage client and team meetings.

As a Project Leader, the individual would mostly be working in the Automotive & Mobility sector, with possible future opportunities in other AMS sub-sectors, including real estate/construction, heavy machinery, commercial aviation, logistics & transport.

### **About You**

* For candidates with undergraduate qualifications: 5–8 years of experience in consulting, research, or analytics, with hands-on experience in the AMS-Automotive sector. Prior experience or familiarity with the AMS sector is a must.
* For candidates with postgraduate qualifications: 3–6 years of experience in consulting, research, or analytics, with hands-on experience in the AMS-Automotive sector. Prior experience or familiarity with the AMS sector is a must.
* The incumbent should be a graduate or postgraduate from a top-tier institute or have pursued a commerce, statistical, or analytical course from a Tier 1 university.
* Strong understanding of the automotive players' ecosystem, including OEMs and suppliers, battery chemistries, the battery value chain, emission regulations, and emerging industry trends.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Take project management responsibility, including leading a team of Analysts and Associates to execute a case.
* Understand client needs and situations and adapt to case expectations; demonstrate the ability to resolve discrete issues and/or drive consensus.
* Communicate data, knowledge, and insights to the entire team; generate and screen realistic solutions based on sound reality checks and recommend actionable solutions.
* Provide content thought leadership, build forecast modeling logic, and potentially manage simple cases and intellectual property (IP) projects independently.
* Ensure timely, high-quality, zero-defect research, analysis, and output, while demonstrating the acumen to solve open-ended problems.
* Effectively manage client and team meetings and deliver effective presentations to the team, team leaders, and managers/partners across the Bain system.
* Serve as the single point of contact for case teams, handling follow-ups and sharing the existing portfolio of IPs and off-the-shelf knowledge to help them quickly get up to speed on focus areas.
* Demonstrate proficiency in research, analysis, and Excel modeling, as well as sound business judgment to derive answers in situations where data is not easily available or explicitly published.
* Take first-level team management responsibility, which may involve allocating and reviewing work for a small team of analysts and conducting performance and feedback discussions.

### **Additional Skills and Requirements**

* Candidate should currently be working in a strategy consulting or research-oriented setup and possess the acumen to solve open-ended problems.
* Proficiency in research, analysis, and Excel modeling, with the ability to apply sound business judgment when data is not easily available or explicitly published.
* Ability to interface with primary client contacts, including Bain case teams from global offices.
* Play a bigger role in long-term AMS IPs with frequent interactions with Practice stakeholders, Partners, and case teams (on cases typically lasting 3–12 months), and potentially end clients whenever opportunities arise.
* Demonstrate independent secondary research, analytical, and storylining skills.
* Think outside the box to solve niche case scenarios through baselining and benchmarking of global best practices.
* Be open to intermittent travel to other Bain offices or client locations for live cases.

### **What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity, and a model of social responsibility.

We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years.

We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration are key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities, and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally.

We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor, and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ, and parents.

135 acres of preserved land and eco - sensitive planning

**About the role**
------------------

We are hiring a Construction Project Manager who builds with AI. You understand how construction projects run - schedules, budgets, contractors, and site realities - and you use AI and automation tools to run them faster and smarter. Internally, we call this role a "Construction VibeKid": someone who can vibe code the tools a project needs instead of waiting for someone else to build them.

You don't need to be a traditional site engineer, and you don't need to be a software developer. You need to sit in the middle: someone who knows construction project management well enough to spot what's slowing a project down, and is hands-on enough with AI tools to build the fix - a scheduling tracker, an automated report, a contractor dashboard, or a workflow that saves the team hours every week.

This is not a role for someone who needs close oversight or a fixed toolset. We are looking for someone curious, resourceful, and quick to experiment - who can take a messy process, figure out what's missing, and ship a working solution.

**What you'll do**

*Construction project management*

* Plan and track construction schedules, milestones, and budgets across our projects
* Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and consultants to keep work on time and on budget
* Track progress, flag risks and delays early, and drive issues to resolution
* Work closely with our architecture, procurement, and construction teams in India and the U.S.

*AI and automation*

* Use AI and automation tools to streamline scheduling, budgeting, reporting, and contractor coordination
* Build internal tools, dashboards, and workflows using AI-assisted ("vibe") coding and no-code platforms
* Automate repetitive tasks such as progress reports, cost tracking, RFIs, and status updates
* Stay on top of new AI tools for construction and test what could work for us

*Reporting and communication*

* Produce clear, regular project reports for leadership - ideally automated
* Keep schedules, budgets, and project data accurate and in one place
* Explain technical tools and project status simply to both construction and non-technical teammates

**What you bring**

* 3-7 years of experience in construction project management, project controls, or planning

* Solid understanding of construction processes, scheduling, budgeting, and contractor coordination
* Hands-on experience building tools or automations with AI (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit) or no-code platforms (e.g. Zapier, Make, Airtable)

**Document \& Models Management** – Understand, analyze, and manage the versions of construction documents \& models on cloud platform ensuring the latest and greatest information is available to field team. **RFI Management** – Early identification of the potential RFI’s (Request for Information) on a project through Drawings \& Model based review and coordination, also understanding the raised RFI to identify appropriate details and portions of drawings impacted by RFI and link the same on the drawings for every stakeholder’s awareness.

**Submittal Management** – Understanding the project specifications and interpreting it to create submittal log. Assist the project team in creating, tracking, and managing the submittal on Project Management Platforms
